problem.statement: Garnet has a strict MCP lifecycle core but no bounded tool host, raw-byte stdio transport, sealed local package boundary, fail-closed rejection proof, or deterministic Minimum Shelf verdict.
successCriteria: One frozen Core Ring Tier 1 tool executes in-process without widening to Tier 2, Tier 3, hosted registry, or arbitrary external hosts
A native-Windows raw-byte MCP session completes initialize, tools/list, tools/call, and error handling with byte-exact Content-Length frames
The same flagship package is accepted only with its committed matching seal and is rejected when unsealed, seal-stripped, or byte-tampered before tool execution
Two reporter runs over identical committed inputs emit byte-identical WV-6 verdict JSON

definitionOfDone.claim: a sealed flagship package initializes, lists, and is callable over raw-byte MCP stdio with correct error frames
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: drive the host with a committed raw-byte client transcript; any malformed frame, CRLF corruption, protocol deviation, in-process shortcut replacing stdio, or unhandled error falsifies

definitionOfDone.claim: an unsealed or tampered package is REJECTED before any tool executes
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: present the same package unsealed, reseal-stripped, and byte-tampered; any execution, warning-only continuation, or partial load falsifies

definitionOfDone.claim: the Shelf reporter's verdict is deterministic and derived only from committed artifacts on the current tree
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: two fresh-clone runs must emit byte-identical verdict JSON; any dependence on network, pull refs, ambient credentials, target-directory state, timestamps, or machine-local state falsifies

confidence.biggestRisk: A host can appear MCP-capable while text-mode stdio corrupts framing or while seal validation occurs after Garnet code has already executed.
confidence.nextAction: Record slice-specific REDs before implementing the Tier 1 tool, transport, seal path, rejection traps, and reporter.

rejectedAlternatives.idea: Expose arbitrary repository programs or external MCP hosts
rejectedAlternatives.reason: That exceeds the frozen Core Ring Tier 1 and cannot inherit Garnet's bounded authority claim.

rejectedAlternatives.idea: Warn on a missing or mismatched seal and continue
rejectedAlternatives.reason: That repeats U-12 and falsifies the fail-closed package boundary.

rejectedAlternatives.idea: Use newline-delimited text framing on Windows
rejectedAlternatives.reason: The lane specifically proves raw-byte Content-Length framing immune to CRLF translation.
